text_block_list.text:
Having achieved her goal of overtaking
Tokai
Teio and winning the Arima Kinen,
Найс Нэйчер
sheds tears of joy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the post-race press interview, a
reporter asks
Найс Нэйчер what led to
her victory, and she
answers that it was
because she gave the race her
all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She declares that she will never let her
fans down
so long as they continue to
support her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер now radiates confidence,
having
become the shining main
character in her own
right.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
